tasks.gr10-bookkeeping-foundations-ethics: Topic: Bookkeeping foundations and ethics. Cover informal and formal bookkeeping, internal control, code of ethics, GAAP basics, accounting equation, source documents. Ask definitions, ethics scenarios, control weaknesses, accounting-equation transaction effects.
tasks.gr10-sole-trader-cash-credit-processing: Topic: Sole trader cash and credit processing. Cover CRJ, CPJ, PCJ, DJ, DAJ, CJ, CAJ, GJ, general ledger, debtors ledger, creditors ledger, trial balance. Ask about completing journals, posting sequences, error correction, trial-balance totals.
tasks.gr10-internal-control-components-t1: Topic: Internal control, the five components. Ask about control environment, risk assessment, policies and procedures, separation of duties, stock and cash count differences, monitoring.
